T1 gives T0 by the standard instance. `IsTopologicalGroup.regularSpace` (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Group/Pointwise.lean) gives RegularSpace G from [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]. `instT3Space` (T0 + Regular → T3Space) then `T3Space.t25Space` and `T25Space.t2Space` (Mathlib/Topology/Separation/Regular.lean) give T2Space G. So Lean can synthesize T2Space G from the remaining instances. The statement mentions only `C(G ⧸ H, G)`, which needs only the topology on G and the quotient topology. The proof, including the call to the helper lemma that may require [T2Space G], works unchanged, because instance resolution finds T2Space G. This is not the other hypotheses being used in a different way, only a redundant instance. Dropping it leaves the theorem true and provable.
